statements.status_notes: Scout SBOM false-positive: /usr/share/data-prepper/lib/ actually contains protobuf-java-3.25.5.jar (verified by `ls`), which is past the fix version (CVE fixed in 3.25.5). The 3.21.12 detection comes from transitive declarations baked into three other bundled jars (verified by `grep '3.21.12'` over every lib/*.jar): (a) amazon-kinesis-client-2.6.0.jar (transitive runtime requirement, falls through to protobuf-java-3.25.5 at classload time), (b) hadoop-common-3.4.0.jar (same), and (c) hadoop-shaded-protobuf_3_21-1.2.0.jar (bundles its own copy of protobuf 3.21.x classes under a relocated package path). The shaded protobuf-3.21 classes inside hadoop-shaded-protobuf are only reachable through the data-prepper hadoop source / sink plugins, which require operator opt-in via a hadoop pipeline configuration; the image's default-shipped pipelines.yaml uses only the random source and stdout sink.
